candidate_state_binding.claim: both payloads were blitted from this command buffer; the state payload binds candidate nodes, accepted history, scheduler and tangent cache; candidate material history is not asserted current for this Newton projection

regional_buffer_semantics.effective_P_and_AP: raw environment-major buffers with mode_stride padding; use restart generation and mode-valid words to determine whether augmented slot is current
regional_buffer_semantics.base_RAP: raw factorized coarse matrix, pivots and validity from this linearization
regional_buffer_semantics.augmented_RAP: raw buffer contents only; reader must verify per-environment restart_generation equals root/substep/Newton and augmented validity before treating as current
regional_buffer_semantics.graph: selector-5 topology, operator matrices, LU, pivots and validity copied without reconstruction

regional_apply_replay.row_mapping: candidate_nodes are environment-major; restAndFixed.w is the raw fixed-node tag; node_ranges is included for selectors 2-4; selector 5 carries graph_rows
regional_apply_replay.fgmres_health: read fgmres_state.diagnostics from the joined state payload
regional_apply_replay.fine_block: node_block_inverse contains three float4 rows per node, including row0.w validity/fallback marker, for selectors 3-4
regional_apply_replay.native_arbitrary_vector_action: not captured; coarse RHS and coefficients only describe the last recorded coarse input
